title: Claim, assumptions, evidence and consumer coverage
statement: Every entry identifies its proposition, parameter domain, evidence class, consumed contract and unresolved obligations. A finite case is not a universal proof; a source identity is not correctness. T2 and missing exact claims stay visibly pending.
assumptions: No renumbering or implicit domain expansion
Release selection and delivery are separate from theory acceptance
boundary: The current 0.4.6 selection and its closed Root do not certify the complete 0.4.7 scope or authorize publication.
status: coverage registry with explicit open regions
runtimeAPI: No new runtime export; these contracts and their native finite witnesses extend the admitted theory without duplicating the engine.
